cards.front: What should you know about graphic communication exam tips?
cards.back: Always link to SPECIFIC designers and works. Explain CONTEXT — what was happening in society that shaped this movement? Analyse VISUAL CHARACTERISTICS using design vocabulary. Show CONNECTIONS to your own work.

cards.front: What does Arts and Crafts mean?

cards.back: Students often make mistakes with this topic. Wrong: Historical design movements are irrelevant to modern graphic design. Correct: Every contemporary design is influenced by design history — whether continuing, adapting or reacting against earlier approaches. Understanding movements helps you make intentional choices rather than accidentally replicating styles.
Research two graphic design movements and compare their philosophies, visual characteristics and influence on contemporary design. Show how your research has informed your own design work.

cards.front: Assessment Objective Focus: Graphic Designers and Movements
cards.back: AO1 — Knowledge: Demonstrate knowledge of Graphic Designers and Movements using appropriate art vocabulary. Identify techniques, materials and processes accurately.

Understanding design history helps students contextualise their own work and draw inspiration from established movements. Arts and Crafts (1880s, William Morris) emphasised handmade craft and natural forms, rejecting industrial mass production.
